senses.gloss: f. (a denom. of πάτελλα, patella, otherwise not recorded) a dish, course.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:22">Lam. R. to III, 16</cite> <he>פ׳ דאת מייתי וכ׳</he> a course that you offer us once, you must not offer again.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:22">Ib.</cite> <he>אכל מכל פ׳ חד פת</he> (Ar. <cite ref="Q01221"><he>פס</he></cite>) he ate of every course a piece.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:22">Ib.</cite> <he>מחדא פטיליקי … חדא פתיתא</he> of each dish you took one little piece.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 74:4">Gen. R. s. 74</cite> <he>פטילקון טב הוא נסיב ליה</he> Ar. ed. Koh. (ed. <cite ref="Q00522"><he>פטיקלין</he></cite>) when we had a good dish, he (Laban) took it; Yalk. ib. 130 <cite ref="Q00534"><he>פטליקין</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="Q00515"><he>פְּטִילִיקִין</he></cite>. Lam. R. l. c. (Ar. <he>עיגולין</he>).
